reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/targ: the org of the client action row the caller read (by its token hash, or by id inside the caller's own org); the app's read tool runs as that action's sender
reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/publ: the org of the one client action whose token hash the holder posted; every statement names that action's id
reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/client-actions/deci: the org of the client action found by the posted token's hash, or the portal session's own org for the portal path
